title: Farewell, Pera
subtitle: Don't forget to bid the day farewell, and to honor yesterday.

content.text: A pair of long-barreled revolvers that once accompanied sisters through countless afternoons at the shooting range—or rather, former sisters.

items.text: Farewell, Pera
The Colonel's Manor

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Eliminate all hostiles.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Find Lopera and Dr. Dores!
Following the admiral's orders, Moldir has followed the tracker button's signal to the manor.
But she has arrived too late. What remains of the Brotherhood have no desire to fight. They scatter, putting a swift end to the gunfire.
The blood-splattered sugarcane field burns, and amidst the smoke and blood, Moldir searches for the doctor and her sister.
Just as the chapel collapses, Lopera makes it through the front door.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Huh? Where have the Brotherhood guards gone?
Neither Duncan nor the Brotherhood guards greet her.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Oh, Molly!

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Pera! Thank goodness this tracker button still works. What happened in the chapel?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I had a fight with Santos, but he got away. Weren't you supposed to go to the Veterans' Residence?
She flashes a brief, bittersweet smile. This is still a victory, albeit an imperfect one.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Rescuing the doctor is our top priority now.
Doctor Dores sits on the muddy ground, cradling her typewriter.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I'm so glad to see you safe, Doctor.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Great job, Pera. Let's head back to the base with Dr. Dores.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: What about the Timekeeper?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: She's on a new mission assigned by the Foundation. It's got nothing to do with us.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Father wants me to bring you and the doctor back to the base as soon as possible.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: What do you mean? Why the sudden change of plan? What's going on here?
No one told her about this.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Just come already. We're evacuating São Paulo.
Evacuating? Since when was this the plan?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Evacuating? To where?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Just follow your orders, Lopera.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: The admiral sent me to pick you up.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Then why didn't he tell me any of this?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I-I don't know! I'm sure he has his reasons!
In her hurry, she presents a reason her sister cannot argue with.
Recognizing her hastiness, Moldir sighs.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: *sigh* Fine. We're heading south.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: To Tierra del Fuego. They've made preparations for us. Come on, Pera, come with us.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: You, me, Father, Ptolemy, everyone. We'll all be there.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Everyone? Why didn't anyone tell me about this?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Because ... *sigh* Pera, you can ask questions later. We don't have much time.
Lopera knocks away her sister's extended hand, taking two steps back.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: No. Why are we going to Tierra del Fuego?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: And why are we running out of time?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: What are you planning to do?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Who's waiting for you in Tierra del Fuego?
She grips the revolver on her side.
She hesitates, fear and confusion flashing across her face.
Her gun is safe. Her gun is reliable. As long as she holds it, she won't be hurt.
She pulls it from its holster and slowly raises the barrel to her sister. With a final crash of thunder, rain starts to pour.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Who's behind all this? That jerk, Ptolemy?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: No. Father gave these orders.
Moldir unbuckles her holster, reaching for her own gun.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Don't move!

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Come on, Lopera. Lower your gun.
The handgun slips from its holster and falls to the ground. Moldir spreads her hands in a show of friendship—of sisterhood.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Father needs the doctor. We need her.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Bring her back to the base and come with us to Tierra del Fuego.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Why? What're you going to do in Tierra del Fuego?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Seize the future, a future for all arcanists.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Father has embraced the Preacher's promise.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Manus Vindictae.
A betrayal she had never imagined.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: No. My family are not traitors.
Not in the past, not now, not ever.
A hunter never willingly becomes the prey she once pursued.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Look, you don't have to do anything for them if you don't want to.
She tries to explain, but she can't even look her sister in the eye.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Just come with us. Come home.
Home.
That single word makes Lopera waver.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Forgive me, Pera.
Taking advantage of Lopera's moment of hesitation, Moldir launches an attack.
As they wrestle, Lopera pulls the trigger, the bullet shooting into the sky and startling a flock of birds.
Finally, Moldir wrestles the gun from Lopera's hand and knocks her to the ground. She lies there, winded and in pain.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Pa ... Why is he doing this?
The pain is the least of her problems. She simply can't understand how things have ended up this way.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: For the good of us all, Pera.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Consider your mission complete, I'll take over from here.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Thank you for your service, Comrade Lopera.
Several Zeno soldiers, returning from their sweep of the manor, arrive at the lieutenant's side.

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: What's going on?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I'll handle this.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Take the blind lady and retreat. Make sure she's safe.
The doctor offers no resistance, weakly surrendering to fate as she's taken once again.
Moldir looks down at her fallen sister, her gaze cold.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I am sorry it has to end this way.
She raises her gun, aiming at her cherished sister.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Farewell, Pera.
The rain grows heavier. Lopera's soaked body lies in the mud.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: Crap! Has something gone wrong?

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: Wait a minute. What's going on here?!
He pauses at the echoing of the gunshot and scans his surroundings.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: Zeno soldiers?

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: What are they doing here?
As an experienced soldier, he knows not to act rashly.
In the distance, a young female officer leads the soldiers and Doctor Dores away, but there's no sign of Lopera.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: That's the doctor, isn't it?

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: Why isn't Lopera with them?
Duncan cautiously makes his way to the chapel to search for her.
The rain comes and goes.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Tranquilizer bullet.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Urgh, I see.
As the effects of the tranquilizer wear off, Lopera can feel her soaked clothes sticking to her.
She sees the tracker button. It's been destroyed. Moldir's bullet must have smashed it.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: It's shattered.
Moldir's aim is as sharp as hers. They truly are sisters.
She grips the fragments in her palm, trying in vain to piece them back together.
But the rain washes them away.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Pa ...
First her biological father, now her adoptive one.
Betrayal. Rejection.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: How long have you been planning this?
There is no answer save for a crash of thunder.
She has no one but herself.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Am I really the only one who knew nothing about it?
Did her siblings know?
Did everyone else in her family know?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Was I ever actually accepted into this "family"?
The bitter thought burns in her chest like fire.
She forces herself up, her arms shaking as she heaves her body upright.
Tears, rain—they both become one.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I have to tell the Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Crap!
She pounds the ground, splattering her fist with mud.
From the shadows of the trees, a familiar figure emerges.
It's Duncan. He's running over to her.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: Lopera!
Finally, some good news.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Duncan! You're okay! We have to hur—
She tries to stand, but her legs give way, and she collapses again.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: What happened? Why did your men leave you here all alone?
He supports the weakened Lopera. She gives him a sad smile.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Hurry back to the Residence. It's Igor ... He...
She can't bring herself to finish the sentence.
The sky clears, and the heat of the blazing sun washes over them once more.
TO BE CONTINUED…
